groups.label: Prepositions of Time & Place (AT, ON, IN)
groups.definition: Core prepositions specifying temporal points/durations and spatial locations.
rules: AT: specific times & precise points (at 5 PM, at night, at the bus stop, at home).
ON: days, dates, surfaces, & streets (on Monday, on May 15th, on the table, on Oxford Street).
IN: months, years, seasons, enclosed spaces, cities, & countries (in May, in 2026, in summer, in the room, in London).

examples.t: Meet me at 5 o'clock at the station.
The meeting is on Monday in Room 302.
examples.m: ON for day & IN for room

groups.label: Dependent Prepositions with Verbs & Nouns
groups.definition: Fixed prepositions required by specific verbs, adjectives, and nouns.
rules: Verb + Preposition: depend ON, belong TO, listen TO, insist ON, look FOR.
Adjective + Preposition: interested IN, good AT, proud OF, allergic TO, famous FOR.
Structural contrast: Verb influence (no prep) vs Noun influence ON.

examples.t: She is interested in modern art.
